title: Nonadiabatic Holonomic Single-Qubit Gates in Non-Hermitian Systems
summary: Holonomic quantum computation offers a promising route to robust quantum gates, but decoherence remains a central obstacle in realistic implementations. Here we develop a nonadiabatic holonomic scheme for a driven three-level system in the no-jump regime described by an effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian.
